searchText: hey, it's me again I have a question about https://ethereum.github.io/eth2.0-APIs/#/Beacon/getStateRoot the `state_id` parameter is described as > State identifier. Can be one of: "head" (canonical head in node's view), "genesis", "finalized", "justified", <slot>, **<hex encoded stateRoot with 0x prefix>**. since we return the root, what should be returned in the emphasized case? the value that was passed in? Tbh, I've left it so we can share state_id definition and not redeclare it. But one might also use this to check whether state exists or not so yeah you should return input value or 404 makes sense, thanks!
